mapper.select: SELECT FROM resource WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId} AND deleted_dttm IS NULL
SELECT FROM resource WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId} AND deleted_dttm IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT revision_no FROM resource_file WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId} ORDER BY revision_no DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.resource_id, r.target_scope_code, r.team_id, t.name AS team_name, r.category_code, r.title, r.description, r.status_code, r.is_pinned, creator.name AS created_by_name, updater.name AS updated_by_name, r.updated_dttm FROM resource r LEFT JOIN team t ON t.team_id = r.team_id JOIN member creator ON creator.member_id = r.created_by_member_id JOIN member updater ON updater.member_id = r.updated_by_member_id WHERE r.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND r.deleted_dttm IS NULL

SELECT r.resource_id, r.target_scope_code, r.team_id, t.name AS team_name, r.category_code, r.title, r.description, r.is_pinned, updater.name AS updated_by_name, r.updated_dttm FROM resource r LEFT JOIN team t ON t.team_id = r.team_id JOIN member updater ON updater.member_id = r.updated_by_member_id WHERE r.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM resource_file rf WHERE rf.resource_id = r.resource_id )

SELECT rf.stored_file_id, rf.revision_no, rf.display_order, rf.uploaded_by_member_id, uploader.name AS uploaded_by_name, rf.created_dttm AS uploaded_dttm FROM resource_file rf JOIN member uploader ON uploader.member_id = rf.uploaded_by_member_id WHERE rf.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND rf.revision_no = ( SELECT MAX(current_file.revision_no) FROM resource_file current_file WHERE current_file.resource_id = rf.resource_id ) ORDER BY rf.display_order, rf.resource_file_id

SELECT rf.stored_file_id, rf.revision_no, rf.display_order, rf.uploaded_by_member_id, uploader.name AS uploaded_by_name, rf.created_dttm AS uploaded_dttm FROM resource_file rf JOIN member uploader ON uploader.member_id = rf.uploaded_by_member_id WHERE rf.resource_id = #{resourceId} ORDER BY rf.revision_no DESC, rf.display_order, rf.resource_file_id
mapper.update: UPDATE resource SET target_scope_code = #{targetScope}, team_id = #{teamId}, category_code = #{categoryCode}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, status_code = #{status}, is_pinned = #{pinned}, updated_by_member_id = #{updatedByMemberId} WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId} AND deleted_dttm IS NULL
